title: Farting strings
html_source:
Cassell’s Dictionary of Slang (p. 491) has the following entry:
Farting strings (also puckering strings): [1910s+, so slightly anachronistic in this case] a figurative part of the body which can be damaged by some form of excess, usually laughter [though in this case, crying], e.g., in the phrase “if you don’t stop that, I’ll bust my farting strings!”
